user.title: Pick your printer
user.description: Choose the Bambu Lab printer to follow. It must already be set up with the Bambu Lab integration, and that integration needs the printer's IP address so it can download print files.

data_description.default_recipients: Phones that get alerts for every print. Anyone can still switch their phone on or off for a single print; it goes back to this setting when the print ends.
data_description.lead_time: How many minutes before an event the heads-up is sent. 0 turns heads-ups off.
data_description.alert_on_event: Send a second notification when the printer actually pauses or reaches the custom G-code. It replaces the heads-up on the phone.
data_description.custom_gcode_alerts: Pauses always start with alerts on. This decides whether custom G-code events do too. You can still change each event on the dashboard.
data_description.show_finished: Off: an event disappears once it's done (its switch becomes unavailable). On: it stays, marked as done, until the print ends.
data_description.early_margin_minutes: Countdowns are shortened by this many minutes, so they run early rather than late. Countdowns also round down to whole minutes, which adds up to another minute.
data_description.early_margin_percent: A percentage of the time left until each event (not of the whole print). If it is larger than the minute margin, it is used instead: 3 % of an event 2 hours away is 3.6 minutes. Close to the event, only the minute margin applies. 0 turns it off.
data_description.event_slots: How many events a print can show. Changing this adds or removes entities.
